build_parse_m8_templates: parse an M8 BLAST output file and return a list of template Biomolecule objects filtered by identity and length
build_parse_hhr_templates: parse an HHR HHsearch output file and return a list of template Biomolecule objects filtered by identity and alignment length
build_extract_template_features: extract template features including distogram, backbone frames, unit vectors, and residue types from a template Biomolecule aligned to a query sequence
